shops.name: Kissa Matcha
shops.notes: Held: only a June 2026 press piece; no page shows it is still open. Local press (CultureMap Dallas, June 2026): opened June 1 in the Asia Times Square food court, taking over the former Meccha Matcha space; the article gives the address with unit #210 and hours (daily 11 am-9 pm, to 9:30 pm Fri-Sun). No own website found.

shops.name: Sorate Flatiron Teahouse
shops.notes: Own site teahouse page prints the address and calls it the new Sorate teahouse in Flatiron (matcha tastings and ceremony by reservation); the page prints no hours or phone, so both stay null.

shops.name: Urban Matcha
shops.notes: OpenStreetMap record (amenity=cafe, found by a Nominatim name lookup) with street address, phone and opening_hours 12:00-22:00 (every day; written with Mo-Su). No own website found.

shops.name: Gotcha Matcha & Espresso
shops.notes: Uptown Charlotte district business directory page prints name, address (zip as printed there), phone, website and Instagram; no hours on it. Axios Charlotte (Nov 2024, Jan 2026) covers the Uptown cafe openings.

shops.name: De Matcha
shops.notes: Local press (Richmondside East Bay matcha guide, 6 Nov 2025) prints the address and 'open daily 10 a.m. to 8 p.m.'; serves ceremonial-grade matcha drinks. No own website found.

shops.name: Whisk'd Matcha
shops.notes: City tourism board (Visit Pasadena) blog lists the matcha shop at this address with freshly whisked matcha drinks; no hours or phone printed. Own site not confirmed.

shops.name: Casa Matcha
shops.notes: Local press (Community Impact, 28 Jul 2025): new matcha bar in Webster (Clear Lake area) that opened July 26, 2025, with matcha lattes and cold brew. No regular hours printed; no own site.

shops.name: Casa Matcha
shops.notes: Local press (Community Impact, 11 Mar 2026): second Casa Matcha, soft opening Mar 7 and grand opening Mar 14, 2026. No regular hours printed; no own site.
